name: Wooden Train Set
info: A 40 piece wooden train set with rails, a bridge and a tunnel. Suitable for ages 3 and up.

name: Wooden Building Blocks
info: 100 colored blocks in a cotton bag, helps to develop motor skills and imagination.

name: Wooden Shape Sorter
info: A classic sorting cube with six shapes, for toddlers from 18 months.

name: Wooden Kitchen
info: A small kitchen with an oven, a sink and eight accessories, made of solid beech wood.

name: Space Puzzle 500
info: A 500 piece puzzle of the solar system, finished size 50x70 cm.

name: World Map Puzzle
info: A 300 piece puzzle of the world map with the names of the countries in English.

name: Animals Floor Puzzle
info: A large 24 piece floor puzzle with jungle animals, thick cardboard for small hands.

name: 3D Castle Puzzle
info: A 216 piece three dimensional puzzle that builds a medieval castle.

name: Remote Control Car
info: An off road car with a 2.4 GHz remote, a rechargeable battery and about 20 minutes of driving.

name: Mini Drone For Kids
info: A small drone with automatic take off and landing and protection for the propellers.

name: Robot Kit
info: A robot kit that the child assembles alone, with a motor and a line following sensor.

name: Kids Digital Camera
info: A shock resistant digital camera with a 2 inch screen and a 16 GB memory card.
